Frequently asked questions

Good to know.

A few things clients often ask before starting.

Where do you work?

We are based in Kalyani, West Bengal. Share your project location and we can confirm the support available for your area.

Can I see the design before work starts?

Yes. 2D layouts and 3D visualisations can help you understand the proposed space before execution begins.

Do you design kitchens and wardrobes?

Yes. Modular kitchens, bedrooms, wardrobes and full-home interiors are among the services shown on this website.

Do you take commercial projects?

Yes. You can enquire about offices, shops and other commercial interiors.

How can I request a quote?

Use the enquiry form or WhatsApp button. Share your location, requirements and approximate budget to start the discussion.
